  ↑l * θ / 2 ≤ ∑ ν ∈ Finset.range l, max 0 (θ - ↑ν / r)

private theorem Roth.mul_div_two_le_sum_max_aux : ∀ {θ r : ℝ} {l : ℕ},
  ↑l ≤ θ * r → ↑l * θ / 2 ≤ ∑ ν ∈ Finset.range l, max 0 (θ - ↑ν / r) :=
fun {θ r} {l} hl ↦
  Or.casesOn (Nat.eq_zero_or_pos l)
    (fun h ↦
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {l} ↦ ↑l ≤ θ * r → ↑l * θ / 2 ≤ ∑ ν ∈ Finset.range l, max 0 (θ - ↑ν / r))
        (fun hl ↦
          of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg LE.le
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg HDiv.hDiv
                        (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg HMul.hMul (CharP.cast_eq_zero ℝ 0)) θ) (zero_mul θ)))
                      2)
                    (zero_div 2)))
                0)
              (Std.le_refl._simp_1 0)))
        (Eq.symm h) hl)
    fun hl0 ↦
    if hθ : θ ≤ 0 then
      LE.le.trans
        (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Nat.cast_nonneg l) hθ)
          (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_le_true (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_zero)
            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2)) (Eq.refl true)))
        (Finset.sum_nonneg fun x x_1 ↦ le_max_left 0 (θ - ↑x / r))
    else
      have hr := pos_of_mul_pos_right (LT.lt.trans_le (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hl0) hl) (le_of_not_ge hθ);
      have hsum := congrArg Nat.cast (Finset.sum_range_id_mul_two l);
      le_trans
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ↑l * θ / 2 ≤ _a) (Finset.sum_sub_distrib (fun i ↦ θ) fun i ↦ ↑i / r)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ↑l * θ / 2 ≤ _a - ∑ x ∈ Finset.range l, ↑x / r) (Finset.sum_const θ)))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ↑l * θ / 2 ≤ _a • θ - ∑ x ∈ Finset.range l, ↑x / r) (Finset.card_range l)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ↑l * θ / 2 ≤ _a - ∑ x ∈ Finset.range l, ↑x / r) (nsmul_eq_mul l θ)))
